verdict.rationale: Stripe's Disputes API supports uploading evidence, responding to disputes, and receiving dispute webhook events. Its official MCP server gives agents generic GET read access and lists disputes (update) among supported write methods, so an agent can retrieve a dispute and submit a response. Full credit is withheld because the story's end-to-end agent flow is not documented as a single path: evidence-file upload is not among the documented MCP methods, and there is no dispute-specific agent skill or guide. missing for 10: documented agent-driven evidence assembly and file upload via MCP, an end-to-end agent dispute workflow or skill, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent handle a dispute end-to-end, retrieving it, assembling evidence, and submitting the response via the API

citations.quote: You can programmatically manage disputes using the API. With the API, you can upload evidence, respond to disputes, and receive dispute events using webhooks.
`stripe_api_read` ("Read data with any Stripe API GET method")
Receiving webhook events helps you respond to asynchronous events, such as when a customer's bank confirms a payment, a customer disputes a charge
